notes: Firepower gameplay causality run. The ball ramp under the apron holds up to three balls on public switches 51 (left), 58 (centre) and 57 (right); solenoid 8 (Ball Ramp Thrower) throws the ball at the exit end into the shooter lane (public 46), and solenoid 1 (Ball Release) kicks a drained ball from the outhole (public 9) back onto the ramp. Public 3 is the credit button and public 4 the right coin switch; they are ordinary column-1 matrix positions written directly because keyboard handling is off. Special solenoids 17-22 are published whenever their sxx.ssSw switch closes while the game-on enable is set. Eject holes are closed and released by hand in the scenario; a solenoid 4, 5 or 6 transition while the hole switch is held shows the ROM kicking it. Run from an NVRAM initialized by one prior empty-NVRAM power-up.
